properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 11:14AM MST until September 13 at 2:15PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 215 PM MST.

* At 1114 AM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area, on the far east side of Chino
Valley including the Granite Creek drainage. Between 1 and 1.75
inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1
inch are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
East side of Chino Valley.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Granite Creek, Little Chino Valley and Verde River.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 2:15 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 2:15 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 13 at 3:43PM EDT until September 13 at 7:00PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
...Observed flooding changed to Minor severity and increased in
duration for the following rivers in New Jersey...

Saddle River near Lodi affecting Bergen County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Saddle River near Lodi.

* WHEN...Until this evening.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 3:30 PM EDT Sunday the stage was 6.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 5.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 3:30 PM EDT Sunday was 6.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage this
evening and continue falling to 2.4 feet early Wednesday
afternoon.
- Flood stage is 5.5 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 6.6
feet on 06/19/1972.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 700 PM EDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL THIS EVENING

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 13 at 2:42PM CDT until September 13 at 3:30PM CDT by NWS Jackson MS
properties.description:
SVRJAN

The National Weather Service in Jackson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Rankin County in central Mississippi...
Simpson County in central Mississippi...
Smith County in central Mississippi...

* Until 330 PM CDT.

* At 242 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Martinville,
or near Magee, moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Magee and Sanatorium around 245 PM CDT.
Mize around 300 PM CDT.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 13 at 3:38PM EDT until September 13 at 3:45PM EDT by NWS Binghamton NY
properties.description:
At 337 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Marcellus, or
11 miles west of Syracuse, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Onondaga, Syracuse, Solvay, Skaneateles, Liverpool, Marcellus, Amboy,
Camillus, Elbridge, and New York State Fairgrounds.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 11:35AM MST until September 13 at 1:30PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 1135 AM MST, Doppler radar indicated that heavy rain has moved
east of the Havasupai Creek drainage north of Supai, though
additional storms are possible through the afternoon. Between 0.5 and
1 inch of rain fell earlier this morning. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Beaver Falls, Mooney Falls and Little Navajo Falls.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Second Chance Camp Site.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Sinyella Canyon, Colorado River, Little Coyote Canyon and Havasu
Creek.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, including Havasupai Creek.

Get out of washes and creeks if you are camping or hiking! Flooding
is occurring or imminent and will inundate creeks and washes.
